Bang Tao villa rentals

Villas in Bang Tao, Phuket

Bang Tao is the long bay on Phuket's north-west coast, a single sweep of sand running roughly six kilometres from the Laguna resort area towards Layan. Behind the beach sits Cherng Talay, a residential town of cafés, gyms, international supermarkets and the Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket shopping streets — which is why so many villas, and so many long-stay families, are here.

Expect beach clubs along the sand, quieter stretches in front of the resorts and a wide choice of houses, from compact pool townhouses to large family villas. It is a practical base: almost everything you need day to day is within ten minutes by car.

Nearby beaches

Villas in SurinVillas in LayanVillas in KamalaVillas in PatongFiltered catalogueAll Phuket villasMonthly in Phuket

Who is Bang Tao for?

Families, groups of friends and remote workers who want a complete neighbourhood rather than a party strip. One of the most popular parts of Phuket for monthly stays.

Getting there

Phuket International Airport is roughly 25–30 minutes by car, Patong about 25 minutes over the hill and Phuket Town around 35 minutes. A car or scooter helps — the beach and the shops are spread out.

When to go

The calmest sea and driest weather on Phuket's west coast run from November to April. From May to October the green season brings showers, bigger swell and red-flag days on some beaches, but also greener hills, fewer people and better availability — a good time for monthly stays.

Bang Tao villa rental — FAQ

How do I book a villa in Bang Tao?

Open a villa, choose your dates and send the request — it comes straight to us on WhatsApp. We reply with availability and the price for your dates, and confirm everything in writing before you pay.

Can I rent a villa in Bang Tao by the month?

Yes. Every villa is offered for daily stays, and many also for monthly or longer stays. Monthly rates and what they include (electricity, cleaning, pool care) are set per villa — filter by "Monthly" or ask us and we will list the options.

The villas shown are sample listings while we onboard properties, and rates depend on the dates and the length of stay. Send your dates and we will quote the exact price.
